hints: Translate the strict wording into integer bounds: 'more than 2 but fewer than 8' means $3 \le X \le 7$.

walkthrough.text:
Translate the bounds to the discrete range $3 \le X \le 7$ for $X \sim B(9, 0.47)$:

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Strict inequalities shift by 1: more than 2 and fewer than 8 means between 3 and 7 inclusive:
$$P(3 \le X \le 7)$$

The complement consists of 0, 1, 2 on the bottom and 8, 9 on the top:
$$P(\text{excluded}) = P(X \le 2) + P(X \ge 8) = 0.1189 + 0.0166 = 0.1355$$

Subtract from 1 to find the probability of the interval:
$$P(3 \le X \le 7) = 1 - 0.1355 = 0.864$$

ai_rubric.observable: Translates 'more than 2 but fewer than 8' into $P(3 \le X \le 7)$.

hints: The intersection of $X \ge 5$ and $3 \le X \le 7$ is $5 \le X \le 7$ ($X = 5, 6, 7$).

walkthrough.text:
Formulate the conditional probability:

Compute the conditional probability and round to 3 significant figures:

teacher_walkthrough.text:
The condition restricts the outcomes to $3, 4, 5, 6, 7$. Of these, those with at least 5 are $5, 6, 7$:

Add the probabilities for 5, 6, and 7:

Divide by the probability found in part (a):
$$\frac{0.4140}{0.8645} = 0.479$$

ai_rubric.observable: Sets up conditional probability $P(X \ge 5 \mid 3 \le X \le 7) = \frac{P(5 \le X \le 7)}{P(3 \le X \le 7)}$.

$$P(X \ge 7) = 0.6496107$$

Calculate the ratio and round to 3 significant figures:

teacher_walkthrough.text:

$$P(7) + P(8) = 0.2668 + 0.2335 = 0.5003$$

Divide by the probability of at least 7 calls:
$$\frac{0.5003}{0.650} = 0.770$$

ai_rubric.observable: Sets up conditional probability $P(X \le 8 \mid X \ge 7) = \frac{P(X = 7) + P(X = 8)}{P(X \ge 7)}$.

hints: The condition restricts the event to $X \le 8$.
